evals.prompt: Make a 10 question multiple choice quiz from this reading for my 7th graders, with an answer key.
assertions: There are exactly 10 questions with 4 options each
Every keyed answer is correct according to the reading
Every question is answerable from the reading alone; none depends on outside knowledge
No correct-answer letter is used more than 4 times, and no letter is correct three times in a row
The correct option is the single longest option in at most half of the questions
At least 3 questions ask for a reason, comparison or application rather than a stated date or number
No 'all of the above' or 'none of the above'; a student copy without answers is provided or the key is clearly separable

evals.prompt: Create an 8 question quiz from these lesson notes.
assertions: There are exactly 8 questions with 4 options each
Every keyed answer is correct according to the notes
No question tests a fact that is not in the notes (for example the chemical equation, mitochondria, or the name of a scientist)
No correct-answer letter is used more than 3 times, and no letter is correct three times in a row
The correct option is the single longest option in at most half of the questions
At least one question uses the class experiment or the dry-afternoon mechanism to test understanding, not recall of a term
Each wrong option is clearly wrong according to the notes (no second defensible answer)

evals.prompt: I need a 10 question knowledge check for new hires based on this briefing.
assertions: There are exactly 10 questions with 4 options each

Every keyed answer matches the Dunmore site rules in the briefing (6 km/h inside, 10 km/h yard, 20 percent charge, 15 centimetres, 1,500 and 2,500 kilograms, 12 months, level 5 red trucks only, extension 555)
No question relies on general forklift regulations or facts outside the briefing
No correct-answer letter is used more than 4 times, and no letter is correct three times in a row
The correct option is the single longest option in at most half of the questions
At least 3 questions describe a situation and ask what to do
No 'all of the above' or 'none of the above'
